content.text: I have reviewed all fee, term, and payment provisions. No minimum purchase or volume commitment exists anywhere.

input.quote: The Licensee shall calculate the license fee payable to the Licensor for each month based on the Monthly Notional Volume bands for that pay period and shall pay the Licensor accordingly. In no event shall the amount payable by the Licensor be less than the amount recorded by the Licensee as being traded with the Licensed Technology multiplied by the applicable Fees set forth above.
input.rationale: The pricing architecture is purely usage-based and imposes no minimum purchase, minimum volume, or take-or-pay obligation on us, so it meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage or ordered services only). Article V fixes "user fees" by reference to "Monthly Notional Volume bands (US$bn) traded on Platform by Licensee" at a per-US$1 million rate, and the monthly calculation in Article V.III(b) is driven by volume actually traded, with the only floor being actual recorded usage multiplied by the applicable rate — not a committed minimum. The volume bands are descending-rate tiers, not volume caps or thresholds we must reach, and Article V.i(ii) confirms the highest band reached simply lowers the rate for all trades that month. The other charges are for ordered services or one-off consideration: the $2,500 per month Technical Support Services fee under Article VII(a) (with Article VII(d) confirming "there shall be no additional fees payable by the Licensee to the Licensor for technical support services"), the Initial Payment, and the Supplemental Payments revenue share, which is a percentage of amounts we actually earn from third parties. Nothing in the document uses "minimum", "shortfall", "take or pay" or equivalent language, so the fallback (12-month cap, 30-day reduction, true-up) is not engaged and no redline is warranted. Two non-material observations for the file, noted rather than flagged: the apparent scrivener's error in Article V.III(b) referring to the amount payable "by the Licensor" where the payer is plainly the Licensee, and the 36-month initial term combined with the fixed monthly support fee — neither creates a volume commitment, though we may wish to correct the typo in any amendment.
